title: Text does not mutate

choices.md: `"east"` — the method returned a new string

blocks.explainMd: `toUpperCase` builds a new string and hands it back. It never rewrites the one you called it on. `d` stays `"east"` unless you assign the result back: `d = d.toUpperCase()`.
Strings are immutable. The method returns a new string. The original stays "east".

blocks.promptMd: > `shoutKeep(dir)` must call `toUpperCase` and return both strings as `SHOUT|original` — so `shoutKeep("east")` is `EAST|east`. Do not hard-code `"EAST|east"`. Print `shoutKeep("east")`.

hintLadder.md: Call `toUpperCase` to get the shout. Then glue it to the original with `|`.
The original `dir` is unchanged after `toUpperCase`. Use that. Do not assign over `dir` unless you saved a copy first.

description: A string method returns a new string. The original text stays put.
